results.question: Can you explain what the NerveSpa system actually is?
results.expectedAnswer: NerveSpa is a family of clinical-grade devices and support products used by clinics to help support nerve comfort, circulation, and joint mobility.
results.actualAnswer: NerveSpa is a family of clinical-grade products and programs designed to support neuropathy, joint pain, and metabolic health. It includes aquatic nerve stimulation, LED therapy, cold laser, vibration therapy, supplements, and topicals. All products are manufactured in FDA-registered facilities and distributed through licensed clinicians.

results.question: Which types of health issues do clinics usually address with NerveSpa technology?
results.expectedAnswer: Clinics commonly use NerveSpa for concerns such as peripheral neuropathy symptoms, joint stiffness, circulation issues, and nerve-related discomfort.
results.actualAnswer: their care plans. What conditions can NerveSpa support? NerveSpa is used for peripheral neuropathy, diabetic neuropathy, chemotherapy-related neuropathy, plantar fasciitis, heel spurs, restless legs, circulation issues, numbness, tingling, burning, stiffness, balance concerns, cramps, cold feet, and joint-related discomfort such as knee and shoulder arthritis. How can clinics order NerveSpa or request a demo? Clinics can open a provider account to order NerveSpa products or request demos. Starter kits and bundles are available. Patients cannot purchase devices directly but may obtain salts, garments, and accessories through approved channels. What are NerveSpa’s pricing options? NerveSpa devices are sold to clinics at wholesale pricing. Retail pricing applies to patient consumables such as salts and garments. Some devices may qualify for insurance coverage under HCPCS code E0720 depending on the plan. results.question: What exactly happens during a NerveSpa foot or hand bath session?
results.expectedAnswer: The NerveSpa Nerve Bath delivers low‑frequency stimulation through warm water to the hands or feet to support circulation and nerve activity.
results.actualAnswer: hands or feet in warm water with Epsom salt and effervescent tablets so the system can deliver circumferential nerve stimulation that supports circulation and nerve activity. How does the NerveSpa Nerve Bath work? The system delivers comfortable low-frequency stimulation through a warm water bath. Patients place their hands or feet in the basins with Epsom salt and effervescent tablets, then the device runs a pre-programmed waveform to support circulation and nerve health. For a step-by-step overview, see the Quick Guide: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ABWl8aU_hrvUSoRkmb3GoHl-rhbhTXIb/view?usp=sharing How should the NerveSpa Nerve Bath be set up? Connect the lead wires and electrodes, fill both sides with warm water, add 1 tablespoon of Epsom salt and 1 effervescent tablet per side, place hands or feet in the water, power on the unit, select Hands/Feet mode, and gradually increase intensity until you feel a mild, comfortable tingle. results.question: What safety considerations should patients keep in mind before using NerveSpa devices?
results.expectedAnswer: Providers screen for contraindications such as pacemakers, pregnancy, or certain medical conditions before recommending use.
results.actualAnswer: Are there side effects from NerveSpa? Most users tolerate therapy well. Mild redness, tingling, or skin irritation may occur; usually resolves quickly. Discontinue if persistent discomfort. Manuals: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IEghxBOy0alvw3U4V9CDd7D4eulpxcgs/view?usp=sharing What precautions should I take before starting therapy? Read the Quick Start guide, ensure skin is clean/dry, use recommended consumables, and start with lower intensity. Increase gradually as tolerated. Quick Guide: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ABWl8aU_hrvUSoRkmb3GoHl-rhbhTXIb/view?usp=sharing Contraindications include pacemakers/serious arrhythmia, pregnancy (especially abdominal), undiagnosed pain syndromes, epilepsy (consult doctor). Use only under physician supervision. Quick Start: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QwjkbWJhezrzXTys7ha8bHr52qRlPJcF/view?usp=sharing Is NerveSpa safe for seniors to use at home? Yes, NerveSpa systems are designed for home use under caregiver or self-monitoring. Seniors should ensure safe seating, proper water level (if footbath), and regular skin checks.
